final_claim: Among all 371,293 normalized monic degree-seven polynomials over \(\mathbb{F}_{13}\) of the stated affine-normal form, the direction-count histogram is 13 with eight directions, 117 with eleven, 1,196 with twelve, and 369,967 with thirteen; none has exactly nine directions.
